## Work Experience

### 1. Diamond Atelier Private Limited — Full-Stack Developer (May 2025 – Present)
Product-based company, working on its flagship product Diamond Forest (diamondforest.com).
- Built and optimized scalable RESTful APIs with Node.js, Express and MongoDB for products, cart, checkout and orders.
- Implemented authentication, authorization and middleware to keep user accounts, orders and payments secure.
- Worked with real-time data processing and improved server-side performance and API response times.
- Integrated a payment gateway for secure online transactions.
- Added Redis caching for product listings and catalog queries with TTL expiry and invalidation, reducing database load.
- Containerized backend services with Docker for consistent environments and smoother deployments.
- Built a responsive storefront with Next.js, React and TypeScript: category and product pages, wishlist, cart and checkout.
- Integrated the UI with backend APIs, handling loading and error states for a seamless shopping experience.

### 2. Appgenix Infotech LLP — Full-Stack Developer (Dec 2024 – May 2025)
Built client web applications on the MERN stack, working with designers, QA and developers.
- Built RESTful APIs with Node.js and Express using modular structure, validation and centralized error handling.
- Designed MongoDB schemas and optimized queries for faster data retrieval and reliable data storage.
- Implemented JWT authentication, role-based authorization and middleware to secure routes.
- Built responsive, reusable UI components with React.js and managed application state with Redux.
- Integrated the frontend with backend REST APIs, handling loading, error and form-validation states.
- Used Git for version control and took part in code reviews and sprint-based delivery with the team.
